notes.title: Update notes for July 29, 2025
notes.content:
[h2]New content:[/h2]
- Key remapping is now supported for both keyboard and gamepad

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
- Added more Pokupara enemies to a cave in Pora Iandara
- Changed the location of a treasure chest in a cave in Puru Puru
- Added a map indicator to alert the player when Kloe's second questline becomes available

[h2]Fixed:[/h2]
- Fixed an issue where the labels for Enable and Disable multiplayer had become swapped
- Fixed an issue where Kloe did not properly mark the location of the atelier on the map
- Fixed an issue where books did not make sound when being opened
- Fixed an issue where museum exhibits did not make sound when interacted with
- Fixed an issue where museum exhibits would be sized incorrectly on monitors of certain sizes
- Fixed a minor graphical issue on the Start screen
- Fixed an issue where Sebastian the Apothekary would not update the player's map when intended
- Fixed an issue where Arcturus would not properly take a quest item from the player

notes.title: Update Notes for June 5th, 2025
notes.content:
[h2]Additions:[/h2]
- Kloe's questline is now fully completable
- Bombs can now be upgraded to Remote Bombs
- Added several new quest locations to the World Map
- New prizes are available from the KuruMart Prize Shuffle
- A new cave is now explorable in Puru Puru

[h2]Adjustments:[/h2]
- Filled in certain areas outside of the Costa Verde zone to improve the visuals of certain room transitions
- Added HUD alerts for most store items
- Made adjustments to Sneezy's dialogue
- Made adjustments to Sneezy's sprites and animations
- Changed the default music track for Marajo Village from "Amazonia Calls" to "Lore"
- Separated Puru Echoes in to two types: Health and Energy, and gave each unique visuals
- Removed the option to choose Health or Energy from Puru Echoes
- The Wave Dance will now remove ailments on activation of the shield, rather than as a persistent effect
- Adjusted the amount of gold rewarded by certain museum items
- Adjusted the graphic for the Aether Wine sign in Allie's Satchel Boutique
- Increased the number of Silver Ingots required to upgrade the Messer from 2 ingots to 8.
- Updated the loot table for Rats to include Cheese

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
- Fixed a graphical bug in Pora Iandara
- Fixed a graphical bug in a Costa Verde cave
- Fixed an issue where Marajo Village would show up prematurely on the Moonstone menu
- Fixed a collision issue in Tia Ibura
- Fixed an issue where multiple zones had their respawn priority list set incorrectly
- Fixed an issue where Pokupara would drop Fire Crystals instead of the intended Quicksilver
- Fixed an issue with Henry's dialogue displaying incorrectly in part of the Sword Upgrade quest
- Fixed an issue where Arcturus could become stuck in a dialogue loop during the Sword Upgrade quest
- Fixed an issue with the glow layer of multiple Munuane robots
- Fixed an issue where Kloe would leave Kokura Buddy behind after leaving Costa Verde
- Fixed an issue where the Tia Ibura Moonstone did not work as intended
- Fixed a graphical issue in Puru Puru
- Fixed an issue where the player could become stuck behind a chest in Yara Tuane
- Fixed an issue with the museum item in Roraima Cave 2
- Fixed multiple missing dialogues for the guards in Windberg
- Fixed an issue where the player could become stuck when teleporting to another character near a climbing surface
- Fixed multiple incorrect Map IDs in Marajo Village
- Fixed an issue where the game would sometimes freeze if an object which started a dialogue was destroyed during the dialogue
- Fixed an issue where the interaction for Hans's bow was "Speak" rather than "Check"
- Fixed an issue with an NPC in Arkanya facing the wrong direction
- Fixed an issue where Marajoaran Dance Statues did not properly glow
- Fixed an issue with one of the cameras in Roraima Cave 2
- Fixed an improperly configured chest in Roraima Cave 2
- Fixed an issue with certain screen transitions in Roraima Cave 2
- Fixed an issue causing Lunar Chests hidden under Bomb Blocks to not spawn properly
- Fixed several incorrect Map IDs in the Marajo Wilds
- Fixed an issue where unintended weather events could spawn on Mt. Roraima
- Fixed a Map ID issue in Tia Ibura
- Fixed an issue in Tia Ibura where a puzzle did not visually return to completion after returning to the area
- Fixed an issue which caused undesired behavior if the player defeated Indira, closed the game, and returned before activating the victory cutscene
- Fixed an issue where Indira's shield audio would keep looping after the shield disappeared
- Fixed an issue where certain voice lines would cancel prematurely in the Indira battle
- Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause Indira's melee attack to not deal damage
- Fixed an issue where the player could still perform certain actions while stunned
- Fixed an issue where wheat fields did not drop loot when destroyed
- Fixed an issue causing Cattails to drop loot intended for Dandelions
- Fixed an issue where Nekrokura Archers still dealt contact damage while stunned
- Fixed an issue causing Munuane robots to drop unintended loot
- Fixed an issue preventing Rum vendors from selling Rum
- Fixed an issue preventing Urkin from dealing damage
- Fixed an issue where a Push-Block in Mina de Plata did not properly save its position
- Fixed an issue where certain Museum Items did not display correctly
- Fixed a missing dialogue sound in Mina de Plata
- Fixed an issue where the Money sound did not play when being charged by the Puru Puru Inn
- Fixed an issue which could sometimes cause unintended health behavior immediately after obtaining a health upgrade
- Fixed an issue where the player could receive more Energy upgrades than intended
- Fixed an issue which allowed other items to be used while using Kana's Mirror
- Fixed an issue causing unintended UI behavior when upgrading bag slots
- Fixed an issue where Kloe would sometimes claim to award money but not actually award it
- Fixed multiple sequencing issues in Kloe's questline
